name: freedraw-pdf
description: Freehand PDF annotation and notebook plugin

scripts.check: npm run check:mixed && npm run check:ink && npm run check:input && npm run check:templates && npm run check:toolbar
scripts.package: node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run check && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-plugin.ps1
scripts.deploy:test: node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run check && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/deploy-test.ps1
scripts.release:test: node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run check && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/deploy-test.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-plugin.ps1

author: vida sana
